sentences.text:
Since both these writ petitions arise out of the common award and the parties are similar, they are being disposed of by this common order.
2. W.P.No.16200 of 2022 is filed questioning the notice in Rc.No.A/2461/2019-5 dt.08.09.2021 issued by the Respondent No.3 u/s.37(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparancy in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Settlement Act, 2013 (Act 30/2013) stating that the amount of compensation of Rs.80,56,902/- awarded against the acquisition of petitioners' land to an extent of Ac.0.20 gts in Sy.No.521/E, Ac.1.36 gts in Sy.No.529/AA and Ac.1.36 gts in Sy.No.529 situated at Tekumatla Village of Jaipur Mandal, Mancherial District will be disbursed to the concerned or will be referred to Presiding Officer, Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and SK, J W.P.Nos.16200 of 2022 and 12823 of 2023 Settlement Authority, Hyderabad on receipt of further orders in W.P.No.23347/2020 as illegal and arbitrary.
3. W.P.No.12823 of 2023 is filed questioning the reference notice in Rc.No.A/2461/2019 dated 24.08.2022 of the respondent No.4 in referring the claim relating to payment of compensation for acquisition of petitioners' lands in Sy.No.506/EE to an extent of Ac.2-29 guntas, Sy.No.521/E to an extent of Ac.0-20 guntas, Sy.No.529/AA to an extent of Ac.1-36 guntas and Sy.No.529 to an extent of Ac.1-36 guntas total admeasuring Ac.7-02 guntas situated at Tekumatla Village of Jaipur Mandal, Mancherial District u/s 77(2) of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (RFCLARR Act) to the respondent No.2 based on the objection raised by the respondent No.6 and in spite of the rejection of the objection of the respondent No.6 by order dated 14-12-2020 as illegal and arbitrary.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the issue involved in these writ petitions is squarely covered by the order dated 09.06.2023 in W.P.No.36006 of 2022 and the same was confirmed by a Division Bench of this Court in W.A.No.1010 of 2023 dated 18.10.2023 and the same is not disputed by the learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition for the official respondents,

sentences.text: Sri P. Sri Harsha Reddy, learned Standing Counsel for the Singareni Collieries Company Limited and Sri P. Devender, learned counsel for the unofficial respondent.

5. In view of the said submissions and for the reasons assigned by the learned Single Judge of this Court by order dated 09.06.2023 in W.P.No.36006 of 2022 as confirmed by a Division Bench of this Court in W.A.No.1010 of 2023 dated 18.10.2023, the Writ Petitions are allowed, thereby the impugned notice in R.C.No.A/2461/2019-5 dated 08.09.2021 of the respondent No.3 and the reference notice in SK, J W.P.Nos.16200 of 2022 and 12823 of 2023 Rc.No.A/2461/2019 dated 24.08.2022 of the respondent No.4 in referring the claim relating to payment of compensation for acquisition of petitioners' lands in Sy.No.506/EE to an extent of Ac.2-29 gts, Sy.No.521/E to an extent of Ac.0-20 gts, Sy.No.529/AA to an extent of Ac.1-36 gts and Sy.No.529 to an extent of Ac.1-36 gts, total admeasuring Ac.7-02 gts situated at Tekumatla Village of Jaipur Mandal,
Mancherial District under Section 77(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 to respondent No.2

Consequently, the petitioners are entitled to receive the compensation as awarded and the respondents are further directed to take all necessary steps to pay compensation awarded together with interest accrued, if any as expeditiously as possible, at any rate, within a period of six (6) weeks from the date SK, J W.P.Nos.16200 of 2022 and 12823 of 2023 of receipt of a copy of this order.

There shall be no order as to costs.
6. Miscellaneous Applications, if any pending in these writ petitions, shall stand closed.
_____________________ JUSTICE K.SARATH Date:15.12.2023 sj Pilli Sadanandam vs The State Of Telangana on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46658274/
